scope: Bounded read-only local metadata recovery plus explicitly authorized trusted qemu-img info/measure only; no conversion, create, force-share, pool mutation, VM start, credentials, guest files or gigabyte disk hashing.
selectedSourceProfile: New independent Windows7x64 candidate; VMX name says SP1 but actual guest service pack/boot/IME remain unobserved

firmwareEvidence.interpretation: VMX has no firmware/efi property, so only the VMware default-BIOS hint is available; this report does not promote absence or BIOS geometry log text to an observed firmware proof. Root must decide the supported BIOS profile or obtain stronger metadata before conversion/start.

limitations: No full disk content/hash or filesystem integrity scan
No source VM borrowed or started
HistoricalV11 Win7x86 results remain their original profile
Read-only occupancy is a point-in-time observation; Root must recheck before conversion and preserve source bytes
